newsitem.title: USA: Mark IV Industries sells unit for $12 mln.
newsitem.headline: Mark IV Industries sells unit for $12 mln.

text.p: Mark IV Industries Inc said Friday it had sold its Interstate Highway Sign unit for about $12 million cash to an unnamed, privately held company in Baton Rouge, La.
The deal is part of Mark IV's divestiture plan involving non-core business. So far, the plan has resulted in proceeds of $102 million, the company said.

Proceeds from the latest sale are to be used initially to reduce bank debt. Subsequently, the money may be combined with proceeds from other divestitures to finance acquisitions or repurchase Mark IV stock, the company said.
Mark IV manufactures power and fluid transfer systems and components for industrial and automotive markets.
